stories.headline: Firmus sets $11 share price for $7.1 billion ASX float
stories.summary: Australian AI data center operator Firmus has priced its upcoming ASX initial public offering at $11 per share, aiming for a $7.1 billion float. Formerly a bitcoin miner, the company has rebranded its data centers as 'AI factories' and plans to expand its operations with seven new sites across Singapore, Indonesia, and Malaysia within two years.

stories.headline: Pi coding agent pulls a 180 and adds MCP support
stories.summary: The Pi coding agent has reached its 1.0 milestone and introduced support for the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Developed by Earendil, the minimal agent harness integrated MCP to simplify the integration of external capabilities and sandboxed interpreters.

stories.headline: 👨🏿‍🚀TechCabal Daily – Meta’s ad-verse ruling
stories.summary: Meta is appealing a data privacy ruling in Nigeria. The regional tech update also notes that MTN has resolved another hurdle with tower infrastructure firm IHS, and South Africa has ended its investigation into over-the-top (OTT) services.

stories.headline: MTN’s IHS Towers takeover advances as regulator demands fair access
stories.summary: South Africa's Competition Commission has approved MTN's $2.2 billion acquisition of telecom infrastructure company IHS Towers, subject to strict conditions. To protect competition, the regulator is requiring that IHS towers remain accessible to rival mobile operators on fair, reasonable, and non-discriminatory terms. This addresses concerns that MTN, as Africa's largest mobile operator, could otherwise gain an unfair advantage by controlling the shared infrastructure its competitors rely on.

stories.headline: AWS turns its best practice framework into an agent that recommends cloudy reconfigs
stories.summary: Amazon Web Services has introduced the AWS Well-Architected Agent, an AI-driven tool that evaluates cloud environments against the company's Well-Architected Framework. The agent analyzes setups across more than 65 AWS services to deliver specific recommendations for improving cost, security, performance, and resilience, complete with step-by-step remediation plans.
